verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents conversational interfaces that let users ask questions and get answers grounded in their own content, and positions itself as a RAG retrieval layer, so AI-generated answers from your data are available. However, this is an end-user Q&A and retrieval feature rather than proactive insights or suggestions. The analytics feature tracks queries, clicks and conversions without any AI-generated recommendations, and natural-language management happens through external MCP clients rather than inside the product. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside the product (e.g., relevance-tuning or analytics recommendations), detailed docs on how conversational answers are configured, and independent hands-on corroboration.
